The waterway key to the world's oil supply is central to the conflict between the US and Iran, which is at a stalemate after nearly seven months, though new mediation efforts took place this week. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Israelis, Palestinians must 'reboot relations': Absence of diplomatic route means 'perpetual war'
item.description: Mark Owen is pleased to welcome Yossi Mekelberg, Senior Consulting Fellow of the Middle East and North Africa Programme at Chatham House.
